body:
Motion capture for any creature from one AI video: two cameras in one frame, a DINOv2 joint reader, the rig fitted in both views, a GLB out.

Enlaces: código: https://github.com/patch-gg/anymove Estrellas en GitHub: 454

README: @patchgg · dragon, giant spider, fire demon, wolf · one AI clip per move, $0.26 each, read and fitted in under a minute.

anymove turns one AI video into an animation for any rigged creature, wings, tails and eight legs included. A video model films the creature from two cameras in one frame, front on the left and side on the right. A joint reader trained on that one creature finds every joint in both views. A joint sits at the same height in both, so the pair pins it in 3D, and the rig is fitted to those joints frame by frame and exported as a GLB.
